source:
You play as Rio, a teenage girl spiraling after the death of her boyfriend, Warren.
Everyone says it was suicide – but nothing about it makes sense. Not the voicemail. Not the note.

[From [url=https://the-slate-is-clean.itch.io/2008demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演里奥，一个在男友沃伦去世后陷入困境的少女。
每个人都说这是自杀——但毫无道理。不是语音信箱。不是注释。

[来自[url=https://the-slate-is-clean.itch.io/2008demo]Itch.io[/url]]
